data_fields.name: melee_luck_double_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: luck 0..100 percent roll doubles the blow

best_idea: One damage function that does a hit roll, then armour as a fraction out of 256 with a floor of 1, then health and first-lethal-hit credit, all server-side.
decision_why: The hit-roll and armour-fraction shape fit a duel step, but KeeperFX checks immunity before armour and rolls from a per-thing seed; both must change to fit server-verified kills and one ledger.
acceptance: A server test: a 0-armour defender takes the full raw hit; a 255-armour defender takes at least 1 from a non-zero hit; a prevent-flag defender takes 0 and loses no armour; the first lethal hit records the attacker and a later lethal hit does not overwrite it.
